title: Bounded-witness characterization
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $V$ be a language of Boolean words, and let $Q$ be a natural number. There is an integer $r$ with $0\le r\le 2^Q-1$ such that appending the width-$Q$ little-endian binary word of $r$ to $x$ gives a word in $V$ if and only if there is a Boolean word $u$ of length $Q$ such that appending $u$ to $x$ gives a word in $V$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language over Boolean words
